official_release_deviations: The released A2C2 repository declares LeRobot 0.2.0 and cannot parse the runnable checkpoint's LeRobot 0.4.x fields use_peft, pretrained_path, and rtc_config.
The local port keeps the runnable LeRobot 0.4.4 SmolVLA graph and captures the same first prefix token with a read-only forward hook instead of replacing the installed SmolVLA source.
No official A2C2 correction-head checkpoint is available; the prior module is trained locally.
The paper specifies 200000 correction-head steps, whereas the official repository README specifies 400000; the bounded local port freezes 40000 steps.
The paper uses all 432 LIBERO Spatial episodes and 52970 frames; the bounded local port uses 40 predeclared episodes, four per task.

The released trainer samples offsets online from every cached base-policy frame; the local port uses anchor stride 8 and four deterministic offsets per anchor while preserving the same stale-chunk/current-observation supervision.
The paper evaluates all 10 tasks with 10 or 50 rollouts per task; problem verification uses three deterministic tasks and five official reset states per task.
Frozen ResNet feature maps are cached for prior training; the live prior still executes the frozen ResNet on each latest observation.
The local port uses the released code's SHA1 scalar task token, even though the paper describes language embedding by the SmolVLM encoder.

frozen_decision_rules.evaluation_validity: all three 15-row arms complete with identical identities, no exceptions, finite actions, nonzero Base forwards, and nonzero Prior forwards for the Prior arm
frozen_decision_rules.base_competent: standard successes >=8/15 and >=1 success on every task
frozen_decision_rules.repeatable_problem: standard minus delayed Base >=3/15, >=3 matched standard-success/delayed-failure identities, spanning >=2 tasks
frozen_decision_rules.prior_improves: Prior minus delayed Base >=2/15, >=2 delayed failures recovered, <=1 delayed success regressed, and nonzero live Prior correction
frozen_decision_rules.prior_saturates: Prior improves and Prior successes >= standard successes - 1, or <=1 matched standard-success/Prior-failure identity remains
frozen_decision_rules.residual_remains: Prior improves and standard minus Prior >=2/15, with >=2 matched residual identities spanning >=2 tasks
decision_order: EVALUATION_INVALID on identity or completeness invalidity
NO_REPEATABLE_PROBLEM when the repeated delay gap fails
NO_DIAGNOSTIC_HEADROOM when the local prior improvement gate fails
VERIFIED_PRIOR_RESIDUAL when improvement and residual/headroom pass
NO_DIAGNOSTIC_HEADROOM for a remaining ambiguous or underpowered pattern

empirical_job_order: VLA_CLOSED_LOOP_ROLLOUT for Base standard and delayed arms
VLA_CLOSED_LOOP_ROLLOUT for the trained Prior delayed arm
